proposition: GET /metadata/runner_dependencies: contract says python_version defaults to 2; implementation does bind an omitted python_version to 3

PUT /v1/trees/{referenceType}/{referenceName}: contract says the OpenAPI expectedHash query parameter is not marked required; implementation does require a non-null expectedHash through the inherited validation declaration

GET /instances/products/{product_id}: contract says each instance measurement corresponds to the unit at the same position in meta.measurements; implementation does read the first monthly total for the instance-key unit and fill other requested units with zero, without selecting their stored totals
POST /groups/{groupId}/artifacts: contract says dryRun=true produces no persistent changes; implementation does pass false to version creation when an existing artifact takes FIND_OR_CREATE_VERSION

GET /environments/{envId}/clusters: contract says sortBy is limited to name, createdAt and updatedAt with optional descending prefixes; implementation does construct a sorting field directly from any nonblank sortBy value without checking that field set
GET /timeseries/recent: contract says a successful JSON response is an array of Tsv objects; implementation does serialize an array of RecentValue objects
GET /warden/groups: contract says the required OAuth scope is hydra.groups; implementation does require hydra.warden.groups through the token scope guard

GET /configuration/groups/{group}/members: contract says each member has roles represented as a list of RoleEntity objects; implementation does return GroupMemberEntity objects whose roles are a map of strings

POST /loans/{loanId}: contract says nested disbursementData.expectedDisbursementDate is declared as LocalDate with an array-valued example; implementation does parse each nested expectedDisbursementDate from scalar text using the request dateFormat and locale

POST /v1/trees/branch/{branchName}/merge: contract says the OpenAPI expectedHash query parameter is not marked required; implementation does require a non-null expectedHash through the inherited validation declaration

POST /topics/{topicname}/partitions/{partitionid}: contract says binary record keys and values use base64-encoded strings and invalid records return 422; implementation does coerce object or array keys and values through JsonNode.asText before base64 decoding, admitting empty-byte records instead of rejecting their representation

GET /api/swatch-contracts/internal/contracts: contract says the default JSON error response is an Errors envelope with a required errors array; implementation does serialize a single Error object with code, status, title and optional detail directly from exception mappers
GET /blobs/{blob-id}: contract says the blob-id query parameter overrides the path identifier; implementation does read clob-id to choose the overriding identifier

GET /level-refs/: contract says the JSON response is a LocationLevels container whose levels contain full LocationLevel objects; implementation does serialize a LocationLevelRefs container whose levels contain identifiers and effective dates

POST /consumers/{groupid}/instances/{name}/assignments: contract says an assignment request conflicting with an existing topic subscription returns 409 because subscription modes are mutually exclusive; implementation does proceed into partition assignment without checking the existing topic subscription

POST /admin/recovery/link: contract says expires_in consists of exactly one integer duration segment and excludes 1m30s or 1.5h; implementation does parse expires_in with time.ParseDuration and accept positive compound and fractional duration strings

DELETE /v1/trees/{referenceType}/{referenceName}: contract says the OpenAPI expectedHash query parameter is not marked required; implementation does require a non-null expectedHash through the inherited validation declaration

GET /api/v1/products/{productId}/reviews: contract says a missing product is described under the 400 response; implementation does raise a NotFoundException mapped to 404 when that product does not exist

POST /consumers/{groupid}/instances/{name}/positions/end: contract says the JSON request body supplies the topic partitions to seek to their end; implementation does install a CORS global handler without a body handler when CORS is enabled, leaving those JSON request-body values unprocessed

GET /admin/identities: contract says preview_credentials_identifier_similar selects identity credentials by partial identifier similarity; implementation does read credentials_identifier_similar instead and leave the documented preview parameter unused
PUT /configurations/{configId}: contract says the numeric configuration-update field is named description; implementation does read and update the numeric field named value
